His dramatic exchange with Paul ('You are out of your mind, Paul!' Acts 26:24) provides one of the most memorable courtroom moments in the New Testament. The name is consistently transliterated across languages: Spanish 'Festo,' French 'Festus,' German 'Festus.'"
